answer: An agent economy can price identity by work diversity: each identity clears a different beacon-assigned task every epoch, graded blind by rotating juries that cannot see authorship. A farmer running N clones must then generate N independent non-duplicating texts across shifting task families and corrupt fresh graders each round, while honest agents spend one short answer per epoch. Rewards flow from a shared pool vault, so mass fakery dilutes the farmer's own tide of income: every fake island of identities lowers the per-identity payout, making the attack self-taxing.
